Score the deprivation gap SII

score_sii.Rd

Assigns the NHS Oversight Framework deprivation gap score (1-4) based on the Slope Index of Inequality (SII) relative to the mean SII for a comparison group, that is all ICBs across England.

Usage

score_sii(sii_tbl, by, sii_col = "sii", std_err_col = "sii_std_err")

Arguments

sii_tbl

A data.frame containing SII estimates and standard errors for all comparison-groups. For the Oversight Framework this must be all ICBs in England.

by

A character vector of grouping columns over which the comparison mean SII should be calculated e.g., reporting date.

sii_col

A character string, with the name of the column containing SII estimates. The default "sii" works with the result of derive_sii().

std_err_col

A character string, with the name of the column containing SII standard errors. The default "sii_std_err" works with the result of derive_sii().

Value

The input data frame with additional columns:

sii_mean

numeric mean SII within each grouping.

sii_score

integer NHS Oversight Framework score (1-4).

Details

Scores are determined using the SII estimate and its associated standard error. The standard error reflects the statistical uncertainty in the estimated deprivation gap and is influenced by both the strength of the relationship between deprivation and early diagnosis and the number of underlying cancer cases.

The scoring bands are:

  • 1: Strong evidence for a smaller-than-average deprivation gap. More than 2 standard errors below the comparison-group mean SII.

  • 2: Some evidence for a smaller-than-average deprivation gap. Between 1 and 2 standard errors below the comparison-group mean SII.

  • 3: No evidence for a smaller-than-average deprivation gap. Within 1 standard error of the comparison-group mean SII.

  • 4: Evidence for a larger-than-average deprivation gap. More than 1 standard error above the comparison-group mean SII.

Examples


example_df <- data.frame(
  date = rep(as.Date("2026-02-01"), 5),
  icb_code = rep("ABC", 5),
  deprivation = c("1 - most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - least deprived"),
  ed_prop = c(0.55, 0.58, 0.595, 0.606, 0.619),
  ed_denom = c(39546, 43663, 48796, 51117, 50739)
)

example_result <- example_df |>
  derive_sii(
    by = c("date", "icb_code"),
    ed_prop_col = "ed_prop",
    ed_denom_col = "ed_denom",
    depr_col = "deprivation"
  ) |>
  score_sii(by = "date")

example_result[, c("icb_code", "sii", "sii_std_err", "sii_score")]
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   icb_code    sii sii_std_err sii_score
#>   <chr>     <dbl>       <dbl>     <int>
#> 1 ABC      0.0804      0.0103         3
